fields.name: title
fields.helperText: Article title.

fields.name: slug
fields.helperText: URL slug — lowercase words separated by hyphens, no leading slash (e.g. chihuahua-mix-health). Must be unique within its primaryCategory. Drives /blogs/:primaryCategory/:slug.

regex.message: Lowercase words separated by hyphens, no leading slash (e.g. chihuahua-mix-health).

fields.name: primaryCategory
fields.helperText: Species audience. Drives breadcrumb, route, and related-content queries.

fields.name: tags
fields.helperText: 1–5 topical tags. Drives chip row and related-content queries.

fields.name: heroImageAlt
fields.helperText: Alt text for the hero image (accessibility).

fields.name: author
fields.helperText: Required. Select the article's author. If no authors are available, create one in the Author model first.

fields.name: showAuthorBio
fields.helperText: Show the author's short bio in the 'About the Author' section. Uncheck to hide the bio for this article.

fields.name: medicallyReviewedBy
fields.helperText: Often the same as author. Omit to hide the "Medically reviewed by" line.

fields.name: showReviewerBio
fields.helperText: Show the reviewer's short bio in the 'About the Reviewer' section. Uncheck to hide the bio for this article.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.helperText: Means the content changed (fix a typo, add a paragraph). Shown as "Updated April 2026".

fields.name: lastReviewed
fields.helperText: Means medical review was re-confirmed. Distinct from updatedAt. Drives schema.org reviewedBy.lastReviewed.

fields.name: readingTime
fields.helperText: Estimated reading time in minutes. Stored manually.

fields.name: shortAnswer
fields.helperText: The "Short Answer" block below the hero. Fixed position in the design.

fields.name: keyTakeaways
fields.helperText: 3–4 bullet points for the Key Takeaways card. Aim for at or below 115 characters per takeaway to keep the card compact and readable.

regex.message: Keep each takeaway at or below 115 characters.

fields.name: references
fields.helperText: Citations rendered at the end of the article.

fields.name: conditionName
fields.helperText: Medical condition this article is about (e.g. "New World screwworm myiasis"). Drives the about → MedicalCondition node in JSON-LD. Leave blank for non-condition articles. Only used on medically reviewed articles.

fields.name: conditionAlternateNames
fields.helperText: Synonyms / alternate names for the condition (e.g. "NWS", "Cochliomyia hominivorax infestation"). Populates alternateName on the MedicalCondition node.

fields.name: faq
fields.helperText: Inline per-article FAQs. Renders as an accordion at the end of the article. Drives FAQPage JSON-LD.

fields.name: body
fields.helperText: Drag-and-drop article body. Use the insert menu to add blog components.

fields.name: metaTitle
fields.helperText: SEO title override. Defaults to title if empty.

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.helperText: SEO meta description.

fields.name: ogImage
fields.helperText: Open Graph image override. Defaults to heroImage if empty.

fields.name: noindex
fields.helperText: Set to true to add noindex meta tag.
